rules.statement: A judgment-creditor is not conclusively bound by an adverse judgment against his debtor, but can show that the property belongs to his debtor if it was obtained fraudulently and collusively.
rules.supporting_quote: "It appears that estoppels may arise by the voluntary conduct of a party or by operation of law, and it seems to me that the principle that a judgement-creditor is not concluded by estoppels against his debtor applies only to estoppels which arise from conduct, and does not apply to an estoppel' not brought about by the voluntary conduct of the debtor but by an adverse judgment against him."
